named.name: Shechem
named.label: right
named.note: Tell Balata, in the pass between Ebal and Gerizim. Joshua gathered all the tribes here (24:1) and set up a great stone under the oak by the sanctuary (24:26).

named.name: Timnath-serah
named.label: left
named.note: Joshua was buried in his inheritance "north of Mount Gaash" (24:30). Khirbet Tibnah is the usual site.

named.name: Gibeah of Phinehas
named.label: left
named.note: Eleazar the priest was buried here (24:33). The site is uncertain.

p: Shechem links the book’s end to its story: Abraham’s first altar in Canaan (Gen 12:6-7), Jacob’s field (Gen 33:19), the blessings and curses on Ebal and Gerizim (Josh 8:30-35), and now Joseph’s bones laid to rest in that same field (24:32).
